items.label: Powerful Performance
items.value: The ShareCloud tablet is equipped with an Allwinner A333 processor and an ad-free Android 15 OS. With 24GB memory (4GB + 20GB virtual) and 64GB storage space, this tablet delivers smooth and lag-free operation experience.

items.label: Parental Control
items.value: This tablet features built-in parental control functions that support creating personalized accounts, setting screen time limits, and reviewing child-safe applications. While protecting children's safe exploration of the digital world, this tablet keeps you in full control.

items.label: Eye Protection Display
items.value: The 10.1-inch tablet features a 1280×800 IPS touchscreen that presents vibrant colors and clear image quality. With low-blue-light technology combined with eye protection mode, this tablet effectively relieves visual fatigue during prolonged learning.

items.label: All-Day Battery Life
items.value: The 6600mAh battery supports mixed usage for up to 8 hours, with a Type-C charging interface that easily meets all-day needs. Equipped with Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4 technology, this tablet delivers smooth streaming and stable connections.

items.label: Kid-Friendly Design
items.value: Featuring a lightweight body with EVA protective case and adjustable stand for hands-free viewing, this tablet makes the perfect gift for children - durable, safe, and full of fun. We provide a two-year warranty service for this tablet.
